keyPoints.en: Kings ruled with officials at central and local levels.
keyPoints.bm: Raja memerintah dengan pegawai di peringkat pusat dan tempatan.

points.en: Funan & Champa: kings with Hindu influence.
points.bm: Funan & Champa: raja dengan pengaruh Hindu.

points.en: Srivijaya: datu governed regions under oath.
points.bm: Srivijaya: datu mentadbir wilayah di bawah sumpah.

points.en: Majapahit: king helped by the Mahapatih.

question.en: Why was loyalty needed in a maritime kingdom?
question.bm: Mengapa kesetiaan penting dalam kerajaan maritim?

answer.en: Distant ports had to obey the ruler.
answer.bm: Pelabuhan jauh perlu patuh kepada pemerintah.

tip.en: Compare at least two kingdoms in longer answers.
tip.bm: Bandingkan sekurang-kurangnya dua kerajaan dalam jawapan panjang.

keyPoints.en: Ports traded spices, forest goods, sea goods.
keyPoints.bm: Pelabuhan mendagangkan rempah, hasil hutan, hasil laut.

meaning.en: Port for collecting and re-exporting goods.
meaning.bm: Pelabuhan untuk mengumpul dan mengeksport semula.

tip.en: Use the headings from the DSKP: farming, trade, forest and sea, mining.
tip.bm: Gunakan tajuk DSKP: pertanian, perdagangan, hutan dan laut, perlombongan.
